## What
Add RED (failing) test function `test_inferred_marker_instruction` to tests/skills/test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh asserting that SKILL.md Phase 2 contains the canonical <<inferred:source-name>> marker emission instruction.

## Why
Story 1df2-5125 DD1: SKILL.md Phase 2 Step 2 must instruct the orchestrator to wrap inferred input source noun phrases with <<inferred:source-name>> markers per the contract at plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inferred-source-marker.md. Tests must be RED before implementation.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Test function `test_inferred_marker_instruction` added after `test_inputs_dimension` section in tests/skills/test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh
- Assertion 1: SKILL.md Phase 2 (Provenance Tracking section) contains instruction to wrap inferred input sources with <<inferred:...>> markers (grep for '<<inferred' in SKILL.md context)
- Assertion 2: SKILL.md Phase 2 contains a reference to the inferred-source-marker.md contract doc
- Both assertions FAIL before DD1 implementation (tests are RED)
- test_inferred_marker_instruction section follows the Results block update pattern of existing sections

## Files to Modify
